title: Concept: package.json manifest served from the web root
description: A package.json manifest is served at this endpoint, so the dependency inventory and the exact versions the build resolved are readable without probing.
applicability: Responses served from a source directory or a misconfigured static root.
risk: Exact versions let a reader match the deployment against known issues for those releases without probing; LOW because the manifest alone is not an exploit and the packages may be patched by rebuilds.
